We currently have three chatops: 

.snap hmac -- Disabled. Use .dg hmac instead.

.snap get-included-snapshots <repositoryID> -- Disabled. Use stafftools instead.

.snap exclude-snapshot <repositoryID> <snapshotID> -- Disabled. Use stafftools instead.

.snap unique-repositories -- This is used to get basic output about how many unique repositories currently have snapshot data.

.snap total-snapshots -- This is used to get basic output about how many total snapshots are currently stored.
